title: Replacement System Installations Contract Deposit: Terms and Homeowner Payment Tool
content:
# Contract deposit — Replacement System Installations

## Terms

A project not financed for its full contract price takes a contract deposit worked out under this rule, and a project whose approved financing covers the full contract price takes no deposit.

The contract deposit is the homeowner's own payment, recorded on the project as a deposit. It is paid when the homeowner asks to pay it.

## Ledger conditions

The contract deposit is fixed only after the project ledger carries the Comfort Club member install credit owed on the contract-price charge.

The contract deposit is not worked out until the accessories charged on the contract carry the accessory member discount owed on them.

In the same terms: a deposit figure is not settled while a Comfort Club member install credit owed on the contract-price charge is missing from the project ledger, or while accessories charged on the contract lack the accessory member discount owed on them.

| Project financing | Contract deposit |
|---|---|
| Not financed, or financed for less than the full contract price | Taken |
| Approved financing covering the full contract price | None |

## Business effect

Paying the deposit records one deposit payment on the project's ledger, dated the day it is paid, by the payment method the homeowner chooses, and lowers the amount the homeowner owes on the project by exactly that amount. The homeowner receives a payment confirmation reference.

## Tool: `pay_contract_deposit_7afff78b`

**Capability.** The homeowner pays the deposit on their own replacement-installation contract: a single deposit payment for the amount given, by the method the homeowner chooses, dated today, lowering the amount owed on the project by exactly that amount.

**How it is invoked.** This is the homeowner's own tool. The agent unlocks `pay_contract_deposit_7afff78b` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `install_id` | The reference number of the installation project the deposit is for, given to the homeowner by the agent from the installation project lookup | Text identifier |
| `customer_id` | The reference number of the homeowner's customer profile, given to the homeowner by the agent from the customer profile lookup | Text identifier |
| `amount` | The deposit the homeowner pays | US dollars, a number with no currency sign, 2 decimal places, always positive, already rounded to the cent |
| `payment_method` | How the homeowner pays | One of `card` (debit or credit card), `ach` (electronic transfer from a checking or savings account), `check` (paper check), `financing` (reserved for funding sent by a financing lender, never the homeowner's own payment) |

**Return.** A receipt with `install_entry_id` (the new deposit entry), `install_id` (the project paid), `amount` (2 decimal places), `payment_method` (the method used), `payment_reference` (the payment confirmation reference to give the homeowner), `posted_date` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `project_balance` (the amount still owed once the deposit is applied, or null when the project could not be read). A receipt carrying `payment_reference` means the deposit is recorded.
